name: curator_classify_removed_skills
notes: Removed-skill classification (destinations scan + evidence heuristic). REAL src/agent/curator.c::classify_removed_skills linked via extra_src (with link shims for curator.c's usage/cron surface) against LIVE agent/curator.py::_classify_removed_skills. Input: one scenario JSON per cup {removed[], added[], after[], calls[]}; calls[] entries are skill_manage ARGUMENTS JSON. Rung order per removed skill: B consolidated-found / V 'name->into' ('' when pruned). AGREED SUB-CONTRACT: only PRUNED-outcome scenarios are gated. *** FAP FOUND (real port bug, unfixed because gate agents may not edit src/) ***: classify_removed_skills passes UNQUOTED keys ("content") to json_arg_str, which is written for QUOTED keys (cf. extract_absorbed_into_declarations passing "\"name\""); strstr('content') consumes the key's closing quote as the value's opening quote, so every field value extracts as ':' and the evidence scan NEVER fires — the C port classifies every removed skill as pruned. All six consolidation-positive probes diverged (LIVE consolidates, C prunes) and were dropped. Suggested fix in src/agent/curator.c ~line 697: fields[] = {"\"file_path\"", "\"file_content\"", "\"content\"", "\"new_string\""}. Additional known gaps (excluded): LIVE word-boundary regex vs C plain strstr on content fields; LIVE scans an '_raw' fallback key C lacks; evidence strings differ textually so they are excluded from the trace.
